draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement

Dear Shakti Cement Team,

We are writing to inform you that a replacement vehicle (Reg: RJ45BB5786) has been dispatched from our Jaipur hub following a breakdown of the original unit (Reg: HR39BZ6168). The new vehicle is currently en route on the Gurgaon to Delhi corridor. We estimate an arrival in approximately 0.8 hours, ensuring we remain within the agreed 36-hour door-to-door delivery window. Please let us know if you require any further details.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
